description: This is a Java test file for the ConceptAttributeTypeValidator class, testing the validation logic of concept attribute types in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes setup methods, multiple validation test cases, and checks for field constraints and duplication.

classes.name: ConceptAttributeTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the ConceptAttributeTypeValidator logic within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test, loading data set, creating validator, concept attribute type object, and errors object.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the name field of ConceptAttributeType is null.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an empty name field causes validation errors.

methods.name: shouldFailValidationIfNameIsOnlyWhitespace
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if the name contains only whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfConceptAttributeTypeNameIsDuplicate
methods.description: Tests that duplicate concept attribute type names are rejected during validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassEditingConceptAttributeTypeName
methods.description: Confirms validation passes when editing an existing ConceptAttributeType without changes leading to conflict.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Verifies validation errors occur when field lengths exceed maximum allowed.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that valid field lengths do not produce validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Ensures validation passes with all proper and required values.

methods.name: assertThatFieldExceedsMaxLength
methods.description: Helper method to assert that a given field exceeds maximum length constraints.
